issue_context.title: Only do ThreadPool worker tracking when the thread pool event source is enabled
issue_context.body:
Per https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/47592#discussion_r569321494, we should only do worker tracking when the thread pool event source and event sources in general are enabled.
